name: Missing external communication data
description: The CRM contains an opportunity that may require follow-up, but the communication system is unavailable or provides no usable data for the customer.

primary_only.interpretation: Potential follow-up gap based on the CRM opportunity timeline.

cross_system.interpretation: A potential follow-up gap is detected, but the communication context is unavailable, so the system must not infer whether the customer recently engaged.

expected.recommendation: Follow up with the opportunity owner and record that external communication context was unavailable.
